legal.licensed: Operated by a licensed security company · Law 333/2003
legal.not112: PROTEGO does not replace 112. If you are in immediate danger, call 112 first.
legal.gdpr: Your data is encrypted and used for verification only (GDPR). You can request deletion anytime from Profile.

splash.lexicon: protegō — Latin: “to protect, to cover, to defend”

onboarding.s1Desc: Behind every button in PROTEGO there is a person: the dispatcher who answers, calls and sends a certified agent.
onboarding.s2Desc: IGPR certificate, clean record, interview, trial mission. You always see who's coming: photo, badges, rating and verification code.
onboarding.s3Desc: Real SOS, Walk With Me, trusted circle and fake call. No subscription, no card.

auth.title: Create your account
auth.intro: Verification level 1: your phone number. Enough to explore and estimate prices.
auth.terms: You'll receive a 6-digit SMS code. By continuing you accept the Terms and the Privacy Policy.

idv.title: Identity verification
idv.intro: Level 2 — required before your first confirmed mission. It protects our agents and you.
idv.idCardDesc: Photograph the front of your ID — data is read automatically
idv.selfieDesc: Automatically compared with your ID photo

home.greetingSub: Where do you need protection today?
home.rideDesc: Secure point-to-point transport with a certified agent-driver.
home.escortDesc: Personal accompaniment for 1–2 hours: events, evening walks, meetings.
home.hourlyDesc: A dedicated agent from 2 hours up. For you, your family or your business.
home.trust: All agents are IGPR-certified, vetted and insured. Every mission is monitored by the PROTEGO dispatch center from start to finish.

shield.sosNote: The alert reaches the PROTEGO dispatch center instantly, with your location. A dispatcher calls you in under 60 seconds.
shield.wwmDesc: Check-in with a timer. If you don't confirm arrival → we check on you.
shield.circleDesc: The people who see your live location when it matters.
shield.fakeDesc: A scheduled “urgent call” so you can exit a situation gracefully.

sos.activePill: SOS active · the dispatcher is calling you
sos.headline: The alert has been sent.
sos.body: Your location is streaming live to dispatch. Stay where you are if it's safe. Your trusted circle received the live link.
sos.cancelled: Alert cancelled. The dispatcher will confirm by phone.

wwm.intro: Set how long your trip should take. If you don't check in on time, we contact your trusted circle; if no one answers, we alert dispatch.
wwm.activeNote: Heading to {{destination}}. {{names}} can see your live location.

circle.intro: They receive a web link with your live location — manually or automatically on SOS / expired Walk With Me. No app needed.

fake.intro: Your phone “rings” with a believable call so you can leave an uncomfortable situation.
fake.scenarioText: “You need to come now, it's urgent at home.” — talk, nod, leave.
fake.done: You can leave now. The call lasts as long as you need.

booking.pickupPh: Where do we pick you up?
booking.locationDisabledHint: Location is off — tap here to enable it, or enter the address manually.
booking.locationPermissionHint: PROTEGO doesn't have location access — tap here to open settings, or enter the address manually.
booking.distanceUnavailable: Couldn't calculate the distance automatically — an estimate will be used.
booking.zoneNote: We operate in the Oradea area (pilot city).
booking.scheduleInvalid: Enter a future date and time, in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM format.
booking.durationNote: Escort: 1 hour minimum billing. Hourly Protection: from 2 hours, degressive rate over 8 hours.
booking.newPersonDesc: Save the profile for future bookings
booking.forOther: Booking for someone else? They receive an SMS with the agent and the verification code.
booking.vehProtegoDesc: Black premium-category vehicle, driven by the agent. Recommended.
booking.onFootDesc: No vehicle — protection at an event or on a walking route.
booking.clientVehRules: 1 · Your explicit consent (signed in-app). 2 · Photo checklist at pickup: condition, mileage, fuel. 3 · Valid insurance confirmed.
booking.doorToDoorDesc: The agent walks you to the entrance/door at both ends of the ride — included in the price.
booking.waitDesc: The agent waits for you at the destination. The first few minutes are free, then a per-minute rate.
booking.accompanyDesc: The agent comes in and stays near you at the venue — a fixed additional fee.
booking.accompanyHourlySuggestion: At {{min}}+ minutes, it's more cost-effective to book hourly Protection instead of accompany-inside.
booking.vehKmEstimateHint: The first {{included}} km/hour are included; beyond that, {{rate}} lei/km applies.
booking.contextIntro: Two short questions. They help us send the right agent — and protect you properly.
booking.threatQ: Is there a known threat (person, conflict, messages)?
booking.humanNote: High-risk answers go to a human dispatcher for confirmation — never automatic.

quote.title: Your quote
quote.estimateNote: Estimate. The amount is pre-authorized on your card and captured only when the mission ends.
quote.cancelPolicy: Free cancellation up to {{min}} min before the mission.
quote.cancelFeeCharged: Cancelled outside the free window — a {{amount}} lei fee was charged.
quote.cancelReleased: Mission cancelled — the held amount was released in full.
quote.extendPolicy: Extensions are approved in-app, with re-authorization.

pay.title: Payment
pay.cardMeta: Pre-authorize now, capture at the end
pay.done: Payment pre-authorized. Finding the right agent…

review.headline: A dispatcher is personally confirming your mission.
review.body: You indicated a known threat — missions with sensitive context are always confirmed by a human, so we can prepare the right agent. We'll contact you in ~{{min}} minutes.
review.backHome: Back home — we'll let you know
review.declinedBody: A dispatcher reviewed your request and could not confirm this mission. Nothing was charged. Contact us for details or try a new booking.

agentAssigned.title: Agent confirmed
agentAssigned.allocated: PROTEGO dispatch assigned your agent. Estimated arrival: {{eta}}
agentAssigned.codeHint: Ask the agent for the code on arrival. If it doesn't match, press SOS — dispatch intervenes immediately.

tracking.shareToast: Live link sent to your trusted circle.
tracking.maskedCall: Masked call via dispatch — phone numbers stay hidden.
tracking.tlCapture: Payment is captured · you receive the report
tracking.loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again. If this keeps happening, contact dispatch.

chat.monitored: Conversation monitored by dispatch. Phone numbers stay hidden.

summary.headline: You arrived safely.
summary.note: The mission report and invoice were sent by email.

history.title: Mission history
history.invoiceSent: Invoice + PDF report re-sent by email.
history.emptyDesc: Your first mission will appear here, with report and invoice.

subs.title: Subscriptions
subs.drumSigurDesc: Night rides included, female-agent option, dispatch priority, permanent sharing with your circle.
subs.kidsDesc: Recurring school transport — same agent, a code the child knows, photo confirmation.
subs.seniorDesc: Accompaniment for your parents — paid from abroad, photo report to you.
subs.note: We're focusing on Oradea missions first. Leave your email and you'll be the first to know.

agentApp.availableSub: You receive mission offers in the Oradea area.
agentApp.unavailableSub: You won't receive offers. Go online when ready.
agentApp.docExpiry: Criminal record certificate expires in {{days}} days
agentApp.docExpiryBody: Upload the renewed document — otherwise availability is blocked automatically.
agentApp.addressAfter: The exact address is shown after you accept.
agentApp.expired: The offer expired — the 45-second window ran out. The mission goes back into the queue with elevated priority for another agent. Stay available to get the next offer.
agentApp.declined: Offer declined — no penalty, but it affects your priority.
agentApp.accepted: Mission accepted. The exact address is now visible.
agentApp.codeHint: The client will ask you for this code on arrival. Say it before they get in.
agentApp.statusHint: One tap per status — dispatch and the client see it instantly.
agentApp.checkIntro: This mission uses the client's vehicle. Photograph its condition before departure — it protects you and the client.
agentApp.photosNote: Photos go automatically into the mission report, timestamped.
agentApp.incidentNote: The report reaches dispatch instantly. For immediate danger use the emergency button, not the form.
agentApp.doneNote: The mission report was filled in automatically from your statuses. Review and send.
agentApp.payout: Automatic payout on Monday, to account {{account}}.
agentApp.blockedNote: availability blocked for new missions until renewal

dispatcher.suggestions: Ranked suggestions — distance · rating · badge · vehicle
dispatcher.kpiFirstContact: KPI: first contact under 60 seconds. Identical treatment for free Shield users and paying clients.
dispatcher.p4: Stay on the line until safe
dispatcher.resolveGate: The button activates only with all steps checked + log written. Nothing closes unlogged.
dispatcher.riskRuleBody: Each mission is opened and decided individually, after calling the client. There is no multi-select and no “approve all”. The client sees “under review” — never an error.
dispatcher.confirmMission: I confirm this mission — my own decision
dispatcher.level2Gate: Level 2 verification required before any confirmation. Without a call + verified ID, the mission stays “under review”.
